listen.script: Girl: Have you ever been to Jeddah, Faisal? Boy: Yes, I have. I went there last summer with my family. We swam in the Red Sea, but we didn't have time to visit the old town. I'd love to see it next time.
listen.q: What did Faisal do in Jeddah?

listen.script: Man: Would you like to go to the museum or the park on Saturday? Boy: Hmm, I'd rather go to the park. The museum is interesting, but I prefer being outdoors when the weather is nice.
listen.q: Where does the boy want to go?

listen.script: Girl: Why were you late for school? Boy: I was waiting for the bus when my friend's dad stopped his car and offered me a lift. But then we got stuck in a traffic jam for half an hour!
Mum: Can you look after your little sister on Thursday evening? Boy: Sure, Mum. I promise I'll play with her, and I won't let her watch TV all evening. We might go to the park if it isn't too hot.
options: He'll take her to the park.

read.passage: Last Thursday, Hamad had an unforgettable day. He was walking to the shop with his little brother when they saw a small cat in a tree. It was crying because it couldn't get down. The tree was very tall, and Hamad was scared to climb it. While he was thinking about what to do, a man from the fire station drove past. Luckily, he stopped and helped them. He climbed the tree and brought the cat down. Hamad's brother wanted to take the cat home, but Hamad said, 'I'd rather find its owner first.' In the end, they saw a sign about a lost cat on a wall near the shop. The owner was very happy. 'I'll bake you a cake tomorrow, I promise,' she said.

qs.q: What were Hamad and his brother doing when they saw the cat?
Why didn't Hamad climb the tree?

options: A man from the fire station.
Take the cat to the fire station.
